name: Heromorpher Wish
story:
In Planarcadia, where wishes can become strength, your desire to "hold the light high and become a hero" has answered your call, taking physical form to inspire your journey onward. Accept it for now, sooner or later, it will become your one-of-a-kind help.

"According to highly unreliable statistics, everyone in Planarcadia has dreamed of transforming into a superhero at some point."
